items.title: Moody’s (MCO) Is Up 5.6% After Embedding Credit Intelligence Into Google’s Gemini Enterprise Platform
items.summary: Moody’s Corporation recently made its connected intelligence available inside Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services via the Moody’s Credit Model Context Protocol server, giving users direct access to its credit ratings, research, and risk intelligence within their existing workflows. This move embeds Moody’s data at the protocol level of a major financial AI platform, potentially deepening customer reliance on its analytics and widening the reach of its risk tools without...

items.title: Moody's (MCO) Joins Google Gemini, Is The Stock Getting Too Pricey?
items.summary: Moody's (MCO) is back in focus after the company reported that its connected intelligence is now integrated into Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services through the Moody's Credit Model Context Protocol server. The Gemini integration follows a period of steady performance in the stock, with a 30-day share price return of 8.82% and a 90-day share price return of 13.63%.
